name: HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd
title: HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd - 541729 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Asset manager with QAAUM up 20% to INR9.3tn and FY26 PAT up 16% to INR28.6bn; flows strong but TER/BER regulation trims distributor economics, with gross impact 3-4 bps on existing book.

triggers.label: Gross TER impact 3-4 bps on existing book
triggers.quote: for us the gross impact is about 3 to 4 basis points and our approach is to largely offset this

triggers.label: SIP monthly flows record INR321bn, +24% YoY
triggers.quote: In March 2026, monthly SIP collections touched an all -time high of INR321 billion, up 24% year -on-year

triggers.label: Equity yield 56 bps, ex-index 60-61 bps
triggers.quote: equity was around 56 basis points, debt 28 and liquid 13. And blended for the year was 45.

guidance.quote: Board earlier today recommended a dividend of INR54 per share

guidance.value: No specific guidance; broadly in line with business
guidance.quote: So, while we don't give specific guidance, these will broadly grow in line with the business

red_flags.label: Flow market share vs book share unclear; management declined to give Q4 flow share trend
Scheme 1-year rank deterioration questioned by analyst
red_flags.quote: the scheme performance and the rank of HDFC AMC among the industry players has deteriorated

evasions.topic: Flow market share Q4 vs Q3

evasions.quote: We can get back to you with this data point.
